page.title: Get in Touch
page.description: I'd be happy to hear from you, answer your questions, and explore your ideas and suggestions. Send me a message using the contact form or reach out directly through any of the available channels.

form.title: Send a Message
form.description: Feel free to contact me for any reason, whether it's a general inquiry, suggestion, collaboration opportunity, or something else. Fill out the form below and your message will be delivered directly to my email inbox.
form.emailNote: Please enter a valid email address so I can reply to you.
form.messagePlaceholder: Write your message here. I'll be happy to read it and get back to you...
form.messageNote: Please write a clear message of at least 10 characters.
form.privacyNote: Your message will be delivered to my email through Web3Forms. Please avoid including sensitive or confidential information.

status.success: Your message has been sent successfully! Thank you for reaching out. I'll review it and respond as soon as possible.
status.error: Unable to send your message right now. Please try again or contact me directly by email.
status.invalid: Please complete all required fields correctly.
status.configError: The contact form is not configured yet. Please contact me directly by email.

info.title: Contact Information
info.description: You can also reach me directly through the following contact channels.

availability.title: Availability & Response Time
availability.heading: Messages Welcome 24/7
availability.description: You can send your message anytime, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. I regularly check my inbox and typically respond within 24 hours, although response times may vary.

social.title: Social Media
social.description: Explore my social media profiles and feel free to connect with me.
